generation_method: Built-in image generation, six individual assets; one targeted image correction; full-canvas 1200x630 normalization.
review_method: Assistant visually inspected all six final 1200x630 PNGs individually and together in one review, comparing finish, density, hierarchy and full-canvas layout with the September 17 benchmark and written September 9/10 standards. This is assistant self-review, not external human or independent-agent review. Diagrams are conceptual editorial illustrations, not product screenshots or measured data.
